name: Weak
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, "Adjusting Creatures" (pg. 6), Weak Adjustments, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=3263
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Only for creatures of level 1 or higher. Decrease the creature's level by 1 (by 2 if it is level 1); its AC, attack modifiers, DCs, saving throws, Perception and skill modifiers by 2; the damage of its Strikes by 2; and its Hit Points based on its starting level.
